svg.title: One source, many projections
svg.desc: Availability of each declaration in the part 2 example across versions v2025_01, v2025_06 and v2026_01; a projection is a vertical slice.
svg.text: Each bar is a declaration's availability interval. project(v) keeps exactly the bars that cross column v.
the two list() bars never overlap:
that is the whole overloading rule
